question: Who of the following wrote ‘Prithviraj Raso’?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chand Bardai**__ .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Chand Bardai:**

 
 
• Chand Bardai was an Indian poet who composed the epic poem "Prithviraj Raso."
 
• He was the court poet of Prithviraj Chauhan, the Rajput king of Delhi and Ajmer.
 
• "Prithviraj Raso" is a historical-epic poem that narrates the life and exploits of Prithviraj Chauhan, including his battles and romances.
